expectedBehavior: Download the candidate Linux x64 SDK into a disposable home, verify the published SHA-512, and run it without consulting the system SDK.
observedBehavior: The 10.0.302 archive SHA-512 matched official release metadata. The extracted SDK reported 10.0.302, SDK commit 35b593bebf, host runtime 10.0.10, and no installed workloads from the isolated root.
limitations: This proves SDK archive integrity and isolated execution only.
nextDecision: Use this isolated SDK only for subsequent disposable workload-graph experiments after the manifest strategy is defined.
